# Summarizing and Replicating: ‘Cross-Validation: What Does It Estimate and How Well Does It Do It?’’


Cross validation is thought of as estimating the prediction error of a
model on the data. In other words, how well is the model fit to the
data. Bates, Hastie, and Tibshirani show that for linear models, cross
validation instead estimates the average prediction error of models in
